name: Trailers4Jellyfin
description: Automatically downloads trailers for upcoming and recently released movies not in your library, from TMDB/YouTube, and plays them before your movies (built-in Cinema Mode). Requires Jellyfin 12 or later. Never downloads AV1 video (H.264/AAC for players without AV1 decode, e.g. Nvidia Shield 2019) and skips dubbed trailers in favour of original audio.
overview: Cinema-style trailers for movies you haven't seen yet
